response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software engineering fundamentals with 20 years of experience and proven ability to architect high-scale systems (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby), he lacks the specialized domain expertise critical for this Principal role. The resume shows no demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing infrastructure, feature flagging systems, or growth/measurement platforms—the core responsibilities of this position. For a Principal IC6 role requiring immediate impact, this domain gap is substantial and would require significant ramp-up time.
strengths: 20 years of progressive technical engineering with multiple Staff roles, demonstrating deep expertise in systems architecture and production-scale services
Proven ability to design and ship foundational platforms (GISCollective, MCP frameworks) used across teams and global audiences
Full-stack capability with proficiency in required languages (C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript) and experience with distributed systems at massive scale
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing infrastructure, or feature-flagging systems—the core focus of this role
Limited evidence of metrics, telemetry infrastructure work, or statistical analysis for experimentation despite role requiring 'high data aptitude with metrics and experimental analysis experience'
Career trajectory shows general software engineering and infrastructure focus rather than growth/experimentation domain specialization needed for Principal-level productivity

key_factors.factor: Strong systems architecture and high-scale production expertise
Limited growth/measurement domain focus versus required specialization
